msg: Hi there, my partner and I are from Melbourne and we'll be staying at a small guesthouse called Casa Coralina on Isla Grande. We're both Advanced divers. Can you pick us up there for two dives? Is lunch included and how much is it?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

The two-dive trip is a great way to explore different reef sites around Isla Grande. If Casa Coralina has boat access, pick-up and drop-off are included; if not, the team will coordinate the nearest dock or meeting point. Lunch isn’t included for guests staying on the islands.

The price is the same in either currency; only the currency used for payment changes. You can book online here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/fun-dives-already-on-island/19?language=en

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD (720.000 COP · 800.000 COP)
• 4-dive package (2 days, 3 daytime + 1 night dive): 236 USD · 262 USD (830.000 COP · 922.000 COP)
• 5-dive package (2 days): 319 USD · 354 USD (1.000.000 COP · 1.110.000 COP)

Has it been *more than 2 years* since any diver in the group last dived?

msg: Thanks, but how much is just the two-dive trip? That's what we want. And no, our last dives were a few months ago.
reply:
It includes two dives at different sites, each lasting 40–50 minutes. Lunch isn’t included. Since your last dives were only a few months ago, a refresher isn’t normally required.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD (720.000 COP · 800.000 COP)
• 4-dive package (2 days, 3 daytime + 1 night dive): 236 USD · 262 USD (830.000 COP · 922.000 COP)
• 5-dive package (2 days): 319 USD · 354 USD (1.000.000 COP · 1.110.000 COP)

One last thing so I can give you the right price and link: are you Colombian nationals, or do you have a Colombian *cédula de extranjería* (Colombia's ID card for foreigners)?

msg: We're Australian. Again: what is the price of the two-dive trip per person?
reply:
The two-dive trip is **USD 124 per person when booked online** or **USD 138 per person at the regular price**. It includes two dives at different sites, equipment, insurance, a PADI professional, and hotel pick-up if Casa Coralina has boat access. Lunch isn’t included.

You can book here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/fun-dives-already-on-island/19?language=en

🤿 *Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day, already on the islands)*
💰 *124 USD* per person (online rate) · 2 people
✅ Includes: hotel pick-up (if there is maritime/boat access), dive insurance, full diving equipment and a PADI professional accompanying the activity.
📍 Pickup at your island hotel.

👉 *For more information and to book, click here:*
https://book.divingplanet.org/book/fun-dives-already-on-island/19?language=en

Is there anything else I can help you with? I can *add another activity*, answer questions, or adjust your booking. 🤿
